description: Kubelet security audit — Offline audit of a Kubernetes kubelet against the kubelet checks in the CIS Kubernetes Benchmark. Accepts a KubeletConfiguration (YAML or JSON) or the kubelet command line flags (text or url). Checks anonymous auth, AlwaysAllow authorization, client CA, webhook token auth, read-only port 10255, streaming idle timeout, protectKernelDefaults, iptables chains, event QPS, serving certs / serverTLSBootstrap, certificate rotation, weak TLS ciphers and versions, seccompDefault, pod PID limit, unsafe sysctls and healthz bind. Knows that config-file defaults are secure but bare flag defaults are not, and says for each finding whether it came from an explicit setting or a default. Returns verdict PASS/REVIEW/FIX BEFORE DEPLOY/BLOCK, score, grade, findings with fixes and the effective settings. Price: $0.005 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: security_kubelet_check
